title: Behavior-control tests on Holmesburg prison inmates
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Behavior-control tests on Holmesburg prison inmates, about 1960s-1970s at Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Tests were conducted on inmates at Holmesburg State Prison in Philadelphia, a full decade after MK Ultra had officially supposedly been shut down.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1960s and 70s tests aimed at controlling behavior were carried out on inmates at Holmesburg Prison in Philadelphia. He says this happened a full decade after MK Ultra, a secret CIA program that experimented on people's minds, had supposedly been shut down, which would mean that kind of testing went on long after it officially ended.
